en: This is a colored vintage postcard that shows an aerial view of a town with old European-style red-roofed buildings clustered together. A tall church steeple and a river with boats are prominent in the background. The landscape on the far side of the river is visible, with rolling hills. The top left of the postcard has printed text in multiple languages referencing 'Zemun' and 'Semlin', indicating different historical and linguistic names for the settlement.
